title: pvGroupDatasets
body:
## pvGroupDatasets

Combines several inputs into one composite dataset, each input becoming one block: a multiblock dataset by ParaView default, or a partitioned dataset (all inputs as partitions of one block) or partitioned dataset collection. Use it to process, colour or export separate nodes together; use append or merge when you need one merged mesh instead. The curated group is the simpler alternative.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Block names are ignored for the vtkPartitionedDataSet output type.
- Later operations that require a single dataset need merge or extractBlock after grouping.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `GroupDatasets`. Identity: `filters/GroupDataSets`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input list for the native Input port. List each upstream node to connect; each entry is a node name or a {node, port} object. ParaView: This property indicates the inputs to the Group Datasets filter. Accepted data: any data object (vtkDataObject); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). | True | nonempty list | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataObject","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BlockNames` | Specify names to use for each input. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `OutputType` | Specify the output type in which to group the inputs. | `{"type":"enum","values":["vtkMultiBlockDataSet","vtkPartitionedDataSet","vtkPartitionedDataSetCollection"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"vtkMultiBlockDataSet"` |

```json
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvGroupDatasets",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": [
      "UPSTREAM_Input"
    ]
  }
}
```
